notes:
Context:
- Mid-market product analytics SaaS (B2B). Heavy product usage insights + in-app conversational assistant for power users.
- Came in via content/benchmark post; did quick sign-up for Hosted API (free credits) to validate latency/cost tradeoffs.

Trial summary (hosted API run: 2026-02-10 -> 2026-02-24):
- Primary workloads exercised: chat-based assistant (70%), semantic search/embeddings (20%), on-the-fly summarization/reranking (10%).
- Traffic observed during trial: avg QPS ~8 (steady business hours), 95th percentile spikes up to 55 QPS during internal demo days.
- Concurrency observed (simultaneous in-flight requests): avg 6, peaks 18.
- Token mix: avg request tokens (prompt + context) ~220 tokens; avg generated tokens ~180. Embeddings calls average 512-d vectors; embedding payloads frequent for nightly reindex.
- Monthly extrapolation (based on pilot telemetry + product roadmap): baseline 18M requests/mo -> ~400M total tokens/mo (mix: 65% generation tokens, 25% prompt/context, 10% embeddings).
- P95 latency SLA target from product team: <120ms for chat completion (streaming acceptable), <60ms for embeddings lookup.

POC & Dedicated sizing conversation (what Redwood recommended / what they want):
- Redwood suggested starting Dedicated pool scoped for production concurrency and caching: initial pool = 6 x A10G-equivalent GPUs with autoscale to 12 for major sales demos/events. Rationale: A10G cost/throughput sweet spot for their generation model family and sequence lengths.
- Estimated capacity mapping: 6x A10G -> steady-state support for ~60-80 QPS (short generations), concurrency headroom ~100 concurrent in-flight tokens with batching. Peak autoscale to 12x for 140-160 QPS.
- Token economics: forecasted token cost reduction ~3.5x vs hosted during steady load when using batching + prefix caching + quantized model variant.
- KV/prefix cache needs: high reuse across users for product FAQs and templates. Recommend sticky shard caching and 128MB per-GPU KV region.
- Routing/fallback policy: primary routing to dedicated pool; fallback to hosted API during autoscale cooldowns for non-sensitive tenant traffic.

Security & compliance notes:
- They require SSO/SAML for console access and encrypted-at-rest via customer-managed KMS for model artifacts and logs. SOC2 compliance is mandatory for procurement.
- Data residency: primary EU customers (10% of revenue) expect regional routing — Redwood private or VPC peering for EU region flagged as future requirement; initial dedicated pool can be in NA with routing policy for EU-resident data to hosted EU region for now.

Business/contracting notes:
- Procurement target: Q2 2026. Budget: rough ARR commitment band $120k-$300k. They prefer 12-month reserved capacity with a 3-month ramp.
- PM quote on call: "We need predictable per-request economics — hidden token surges kill our margins. If Dedicated gets us 3x cost reduction and consistent latency, we'll sign sooner."
